prompt:
A flat vector app icon, filling a perfect square edge to edge with no border and no
rounded corners.

BACKGROUND: a solid, completely flat warm off-white field, hex #faf8f9. Absolutely
uniform — no gradient, no texture, no vignette, no noise.

MAIN MOTIF — mountain range that is also a line chart: across the lower two thirds of
the square, a range of five sharp, angular, abstract mountain peaks rendered as clean
geometric triangles with straight edges. The upper ridgeline of the range is emphasised
as a single continuous bold polyline stroke, like the plotted series of a line chart,
stepping generally upward from the low left to the tallest peak at the right of centre.
At every vertex of that ridgeline — each summit and each valley — sits a small solid
filled circle, exactly like the data-point markers of a chart. The circles are the same
size as each other and clearly visible.

DEPTH: two overlapping layers of peaks. The rear range is a lighter, softer violet and
sits higher and further back; the front range is the deep saturated violet and overlaps
it. Flat fills only, hard edges where they overlap, no shading, no gradients, no
atmospheric haze.

RESERVED CLEAR BAND: a horizontal band across the vertical middle of the square, spanning
the full width and about one third of the square's height, is kept visually calm and
uncluttered — a quiet zone. The peaks pass behind it as broad, plain, unmodulated fields
of flat colour, with no ridgeline vertices, no data-point circles, no fine detail and no
busy overlaps falling inside that band. Everything intricate sits above it or below it.
This band is a smooth resting surface.

WHOLLY WORDLESS: the image is purely graphic and contains no lettering of any kind — no
words, no captions, no numerals, no signature, no watermark, no monogram, no axis labels,
no tagline, no typography anywhere.

COLOR PALETTE (strict, use nothing outside this list):
            summit, which is the one warm focal accent in the whole icon

COMPOSITION: square 1:1. The mountain range spans the full width, its bases running off
the left and right edges. The tallest peak rises to about 70% of the square's height.
Generous clear space at the very top of the square. The whole mark is balanced,
symmetrical in weight, and instantly readable when shrunk to a thumbnail.

STYLE: flat two-dimensional vector illustration, Swiss poster geometry, crisp hard
edges, solid unmodulated fills, thick confident strokes. Original and unbranded — an
independent design containing no company logo, badge, emblem or third-party mark of any
kind. Not photorealistic, not painterly, not three-dimensional, no drop shadows, no
glow, no gloss, no reflections, no outlines around the square itself.
